items.title: Gravatal (SC) Food & catering procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #PRI 74
items.en_title: Gravatal (SC) Food & catering procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #PRI 74
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Gravatal (SC) is procuring food, catering or related supplies through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 940,000; proposals close Nov 24, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
